description:
You are a Solutions Architect at a cloud consulting firm. A client is launching a multi-tenant SaaS application on AWS and needs a formal architecture diagram for their security review board. The architecture requirements document is at ~/Desktop/saas_arch_requirements.txt.

Using draw.io's built-in AWS shape library (enable it via Extras > Edit Diagram or the shape panel), create a complete AWS architecture diagram with ALL of the following components:

NETWORK LAYER: 1 VPC spanning 2 Availability Zones, each AZ has 1 public subnet and 1 private subnet (4 subnets total). An Internet Gateway attached to the VPC. 1 NAT Gateway in each public subnet.

COMPUTE LAYER: Application Load Balancer in the public subnets. 2 EC2 instances (one per AZ) in private subnets behind the ALB. An Auto Scaling Group encompassing the EC2 instances.

DATA LAYER: RDS Multi-AZ instance (PostgreSQL) in private subnets. ElastiCache Redis cluster in private subnets. S3 bucket for static assets.

EDGE/CDN LAYER: CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB. Route 53 hosted zone.

SECURITY: Security Group boundaries shown as dashed rectangles around: (a) public subnets, (b) private subnets, (c) data layer.

Create a second page titled 'Data Flow' showing the request path: User -> CloudFront -> ALB -> EC2 -> RDS/ElastiCache as a sequence of labeled arrows.

Save as ~/Desktop/aws_architecture.drawio and export page 1 as ~/Desktop/aws_architecture.png.
